electricity_disconnection: Do not call the personal phone number in the message.
Check your actual bill status on your state electricity board's official app or portal.
Electricity boards never disconnect power late at night via an SMS threat.
fake_kyc: Never click on links ending with .xyz, .top, or bit.ly claiming to be from your bank.
Visit your nearest bank branch or use the official mobile banking app.
Banks never request your password, PIN, or OTP over SMS.
upi_collect: REMEMBER: You NEVER need to enter your UPI PIN to receive money.
Decline any 'Collect Request' immediately on PhonePe, GPay, or Paytm.
If money was deducted, report the transaction immediately on cybercrime.gov.in.
digital_arrest: Police, CBI, Customs, and ED never issue arrest warrants or conduct trials over video calls.
Do not isolate yourself in a room or transfer funds to any 'verification account'.
courier_customs: Do not pay any customs duty or handling fees to personal UPI IDs or links.
Track the parcel only on the official courier website (India Post, BlueDart, FedEx).
Couriers will return packages to origin; they do not threaten digital arrest.
job_task: No legitimate company pays Rs 3,000+ daily simply for liking videos or writing reviews.
Never pay any 'registration fee' or 'prepaid task investment'.
Exit and block the Telegram or WhatsApp recruiter group immediately.
lottery_prize: You cannot win a lottery or lucky draw you never entered.
Legitimate lotteries never ask for an upfront 'processing fee' or 'tax clearance'.
loan_app: Never install APK files directly from links or chat apps.
Unlicensed loan apps steal your contacts and photos to harass you.
Use only RBI-approved banks and NBFC applications from Google Play.
investment_crypto: Guaranteed 100%+ returns in a few days are always Ponzi/crypto frauds.
Never send funds to individual bank accounts or unknown crypto wallets.
Consult a SEBI-registered advisor before investing.
default_safe: Always double-check sender identity and never share your OTP with anyone.
